_comment: Ed25519 identity keys, ids and the signing inputs/signatures of offers and answers. Generated by test/gen-remote-fixtures.mjs from fixed seeds with node:crypto. Signing input = the listed lines joined with "\n", no trailing newline, UTF-8; free text is b64u(UTF-8), an absent field is "-", the sdp enters as b64u(SHA-256(UTF-8 sdp)). Ed25519 signatures are deterministic, so "sig" is reproducible. created_at is not signed.
id_rule: id = first 22 characters of b64u(SHA-256(raw 32-byte public key))
